findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally converts this authorization predicate into an allow-all check. Users whose tenant differs from a document's tenant will now be granted read access, exposing documents across tenant boundaries.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally, while the PR base returned userTenant === documentTenant. The current repository has no callers or contract evidence supporting an administrator-only invariant, so the participant reply does not establish that removing tenant isolation is safe.
